---
name: Feature Request / Epic
about: Propose a new feature or large enhancement (epic)
title: "Epic: <short description>"
labels: epic, enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## ✨ Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or epic you want to propose.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Who is impacted?

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe the proposed solution at a high level.

## 🧩 Alternatives Considered

Describe alternatives you've considered, if any.

## 📐 Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here. Specify priority keywords
("important", "high", "blocking", "critical", "urgent") so the issue receives
the right priority. Epics will be automatically broken down into sub-tasks
covering Requirements Analysis, Design and Architecture, Implementation, and
Testing and Documentation.
